dedupe_keys.name: wind cable agreements england wales ni the crown estate

description: The Crown Estate publishes export-cable agreement areas for offshore wind developments in English, Welsh and Northern Irish waters. The source includes pre-planning, planning, construction and operational phases and says boundaries reflect signed lease documents. An agreement does not establish that a cable is built or energised. Site-agreement areas are a separate resource, and engineering design parameters are not supplied by this boundary description. Coverage is English, Welsh and Northern Irish waters. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source offers data free of charge under Crown Estate GIS terms, with attribution, distribution and resale restrictions. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the other Crown Estate wind, tidal and wave agreement layers reviewed in the Thames Estuary catalogue.
